# rasuvaeff/yii3-metrics

Vendor-neutral metrics core for Yii3: `MetricRegistry` facade over counters,
gauges, histograms + PSR-15 RED middleware. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics`.
Instruments are interfaces; state lives in a backend. Core ships `Null*` (no-op)
and `InMemory*` (dev/test) only.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-metrics
```

Backend (real export): `rasuvaeff/yii3-metrics-prometheus`. Without one,
bind `MeterProviderInterface => NullMeterProvider`.

## Rules

- Metric names are Prometheus-strict `^[a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*$` (underscores, NO
  dots). Label names `^[a-zA-Z_]\w*$` (validated by `LabelSet`).
- A meter keeps per-name accumulating state — `counter('x')` twice → same
  series. A counter rejects `inc()` with a negative amount.
- Recorded amounts MUST be finite: `counter->inc`, `histogram->observe`,
  `upDownCounter->add`, `gauge->inc|dec` throw on `NAN`/`±INF`. `gauge->set` is
  absolute: `±INF` ok, `NAN` throws (no renderable token).
- Gauge = measured absolute value (`set()`); UpDownCounter = counted ups/downs
  (`add(±δ)`) — prefer it for counted values: deltas aggregate correctly across
  php-fpm workers, gauge inc/dec tallies are process-local.
- Structural validation (name regex, bucket monotonicity) runs even in `NullMeter`;
  the negative-inc guard runs only in recording impls.
- `config/di.php` binds ONLY the facade (`MetricRegistry`) + `RouteResolverInterface`.
  NEVER bind `MeterProviderInterface` in core (one backend/app owns it, else
  `yiisoft/config` Duplicate key).
- Histograms are cumulative (`le`); `+Inf` appended implicitly.
- RED `route` label defaults to the CONSTANT `(unset)` (`ConstantRouteResolver`):
  the shipped default never reads the URI (raw path = cardinality explosion +
  token leak into `/metrics`). A path-derived label is opt-in — rebind
  `RouteResolverInterface`. Duration via `hrtime` (no telemetry dependency).
- `Buckets::PROMETHEUS_DEFAULTS` — public default histogram bounds (seconds,
  finite, NO trailing `+Inf`); backends append their own overflow bucket.

## API

### Registry / instruments

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\{MetricRegistry, LabelSet};

$c = $registry->counter('orders_total', 'help', ['channel']);
$c->inc(1.0, new LabelSet(['channel' => 'web']));

$g = $registry->gauge('room_temperature');
$g->set(21.5); $g->inc(); $g->dec();

$u = $registry->upDownCounter('inflight_jobs');
$u->add(1.0); $u->add(-1.0);

$h = $registry->histogram('db_seconds', 'help', ['op'], [0.01, 0.1, 1.0]); // finite bounds; +Inf auto
$h->observe(0.023, new LabelSet(['op' => 'select']));
```

Signatures: `counter(name, help='', labelNames=[]): CounterInterface`;
`gauge(...): GaugeInterface`; `upDownCounter(...): UpDownCounterInterface`;
`histogram(name, help='', labelNames=[], buckets=[]): HistogramInterface`.
`CounterInterface::inc(float $amount=1.0, LabelSet $labels=new LabelSet())`.
`GaugeInterface::set|inc|dec(float, LabelSet)`.
`UpDownCounterInterface::add(float $delta, LabelSet)`.
`HistogramInterface::observe(float, LabelSet)`.

### Providers

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\{NullMeterProvider, InMemoryMeterProvider, MetricRegistry};

new MetricRegistry(new NullMeterProvider());     // no-op
$p = new InMemoryMeterProvider();                // dev/test
$p->snapshots();                                 // list<MetricSnapshot> (no timestamp)
```

### RED middleware (PSR-15)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\{RedMetricsMiddleware, RouteResolverInterface};

new RedMetricsMiddleware($registry);                 // route = '(unset)' (safe default)
new RedMetricsMiddleware($registry, $routeResolver); // custom route label
new RedMetricsMiddleware($registry, durationBuckets: [0.1, 1.0, 10.0]); // custom histogram bounds (s)
new RedMetricsMiddleware($registry, excludedPaths: ['/metrics']); // skip scrape/probe endpoints (exact paths)
// yiisoft/config: params 'rasuvaeff/yii3-metrics' => ['red' => ['duration_buckets' => [...], 'excluded_paths' => [...]]]
// records http_server_requests_total{method,route,status}
//         http_server_request_duration_seconds{method,route,status}
// status = '500' when the handler throws.
```

### Route resolvers

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\{BoundedRouteResolver, ConstantRouteResolver, PathRouteResolver};

new ConstantRouteResolver();          // '(unset)' — DI + middleware default, ignores the request
new ConstantRouteResolver('app');     // custom constant
new PathRouteResolver();              // opt-in raw path: cardinality + token-leak risk
new BoundedRouteResolver(new PathRouteResolver(), limit: 100, overflow: '(other)');
// bounded: first `limit` distinct values pass, the rest collapse to `overflow`;
// limit < 1 throws. Stateful, per process — bind one shared instance.
```

### CurrentRouteResolver (yiisoft/router, optional dep)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\CurrentRouteResolver;

// route label = matched route pattern '/users/{id}' (low-cardinality).
// Unmatched (404) => '(unmatched)', or the fallback resolver if given.
new CurrentRouteResolver($currentRoute);                                  // Yiisoft\Router\CurrentRoute
new CurrentRouteResolver($currentRoute, fallback: new PathRouteResolver());
// Rebind app-side: RouteResolverInterface::class => CurrentRouteResolver::class.
// RedMetricsMiddleware must sit BEFORE the router middleware (label resolved
// after the handler ran, when CurrentRoute is populated).
```

### LabelSet

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\LabelSet;

$l = new LabelSet(['method' => 'GET', 'code' => 200]); // scalar values coerced to string
$l->labels;   // ['code' => '200', 'method' => 'GET'] (sorted)
$l->equals($other); $l->key(); $l->names(); $l->isEmpty();
// key() is length-prefixed ('4:code=3:200,6:method=3:GET') so it is injective
// even when values contain '=' or ','. Compare sets with equals(), not keys.
```

Invalid label names throw `Exception\InvalidArgumentException`.
